definitions.explanation: A method of random selection, typically used for deciding winners in competitions, allocating tickets, or distributing prizes.

examples.japanese: {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当選者|とうせんしゃ}→当選者：26293_tousensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We'll decide the winner by lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Concert tickets will be sold through a lottery.

examples.japanese: {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
examples.english: I entered the lottery but didn't win.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}→先着順：07057_senchakujun⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{焦|あせ}る→焦る：04619_aseru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's by lottery, not first-come-first-served, so there's no need to rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦{倍率|ばいりつ}→倍率：15067_bairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{当|あ}たらない→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: Popular events have high lottery odds, so it's hard to win.

notes:
{抽選|ちゅうせん} is selection by drawing lots. In Japan it is the standard way of rationing anything oversubscribed: concert tickets, popular restaurant slots, public housing, marathon entries, and school places.

USAGE:
- The method takes ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (decide by lottery)
- The draw you enter or fail takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧, {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧
- Also used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ when an organiser holds the draw

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to win a draw
- {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sale by lottery
- {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the result of the draw
- {抽選|ちゅうせん}⟦{倍率|ばいりつ}→倍率：15067_bairitsu⟧: the odds, expressed as applicants per place

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}→先着順：07057_senchakujun⟧ (first-come, first-served) is the other common rationing method, and notices usually state which one applies. {抽選|ちゅうせん} rewards nobody for being quick; {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} rewards nothing else.
